text:
Palladium Price in 2012
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2012, the LBMA palladium price rose 1.7% between 2012-01-31 ($692) and 2012-12-28 ($704). The highest sampled price was $722 in February and the lowest was $578 in June. The mean of these observations was $649. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
